title: Day One Native Reader
summary: Claire 自用 iPad Native Reader 已驗證 Day One JSON、structured richText、Search/Tag、photos[].appleLocalIdentifier → PhotoKit → bounded inline image，以及同篇日記 full-screen 左右瀏覽；圖片牆方案因可重現 scroll regression 且非 data-sovereignty 核心需求而放棄，PDF physical rendering 明確排除。
flow: Day One JSON → Swift Native Model → Rich Text Renderer + Search / Tag → richText photo identifier → photos[].appleLocalIdentifier → PhotoKit → Inline Image → Full-screen Entry Photo Viewer
